data.name: Roop
data.gender_notes: Roop is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The word Roop comes from the Sanskrit word 'Rupam' which means form or shape. It is also a term used in Hinduism to describe the divine form of a deity. The name Roop signifies beauty, radiance, and the idea of taking shape or form. The name Roop carries the meaning “Shape, Form, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Roop usually hope their child will grow to embody shape, form, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, the name Roop is believed to be a representation of the divine form of a deity. It is a reminder of the beauty and majesty of the universe and the spiritual essence within us all.
data.etymology: Roop belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shape, Form, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roop total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
